source.title: In-house chromogenic anti-factor Xa assay: development, validation, and identification of factors predicting APTT discordance

known_source_consistency_flags: Patient/sample allocation conflict: 190 samples from 110 total patients vs. derivation described as 80 specimens from 80 different patients and modeling set as 110 specimens from 110 different patients independent of derivation.
Figure 1 time-unit conflict: x-axis labels incubation time in minutes while body/caption describe seconds.
Figure 4 caption regression equation conflicts with the plotted equation and main-text equation.
Figure 8 caption reports n=120 while main-text method comparison reports n=80.
Figure 9 Bland–Altman mean-bias value differs between caption (0.005 IU/mL) and Discussion (−0.008 IU/mL).
Figure 10 caption reports n=110 while text identifies the APTT calibration analysis as the n=80 derivation set.
Figure 11 plotted/caption ROC AUCs and cutoffs differ from section 3.4.3 main-text values used for the final APTT range.
Figure 12 heatmap diagonal totals 57/110 while the text reports 46/110 concordant and gives concordant category counts 8/32/6.
Figure 14 prose, caption, and flowchart contain conflicting eGFR direction and AT-III branch logic.
